{{Top|leg}}
'''Gydio Lucone''' was a usurer without qualms.

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Lucone was approached by captain [[Elga Arbo]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] specialized in fast deliveries. Arbo had bought a modified [[Starfeld Industries/Legends|Starfeld Industries]] [[Z-10 Seeker-class scout ship|Z-10 Seeker]], the ''[[Redshift Runner]]'', and wanted to borrow money from Lucone to improve the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Lucone agreed.<ref name="Stock Ships">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

Lucone had purposefully signed strict conditions so that, should Arbo did not pay monthly, Lucone would then impound the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Lucone did hope this situation would happen, as it would give Lucone the chance to blackmail Arbo and make her [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] for Lucone. However, Arbo systematically paid in time and at the same time, she got a reputation as a legal pilot.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

One day, Arbo wanted to pay three days after her deadline. Lucone attempted to claim the ship. Arbo refused and violence ensued. Arbo was seriously injured during the fight, but she and [[Maceb Joodsen]] eventually escaped on the ''Runner''.<ref name="Stock Ships" />

Enraged, Lucone then issued a 20,000-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for the ship and took measures so that it was a well-known fact. Three months later, the bounty had not been claimed.<ref name="Stock Ships" />
